scripts.predev: pnpm prepare:sdk && pnpm prepare:api && node scripts/gen-snippets.mjs
scripts.prebuild: pnpm prepare:sdk && pnpm prepare:api && node scripts/gen-snippets.mjs
scripts.dev: if [ -n "$PAYKIT_PLAYGROUND_API_URL" ]; then echo "Using external playground API at $PAYKIT_PLAYGROUND_API_URL"; pnpm -C app dev:prepared; else PLAYGROUND_PORT=${PLAYGROUND_PORT:-3000} concurrently -n api,app -c cyan,magenta "PORT=$PLAYGROUND_PORT pnpm -C ../typescript/examples/playground-api dev" "PLAYGROUND_PORT=$PLAYGROUND_PORT pnpm -C app dev:prepared"; fi
scripts.build: pnpm -C app build:prepared && pnpm -C ../typescript/examples/playground-api build && pnpm check-snippets
